mapper.select: SELECT p.category_id,o.status,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE SUBSTRING(o.order_no,3,4)=CAST(YEAR(#{from}) AS CHAR) GROUP BY p.category_id,o.status ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.category_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (o.channel='APP' OR i.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM shopping_cart_item GROUP BY sku_id HAVING SUM(quantity)>3)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel dimension,'single' metric,COUNT(*) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (i.quantity=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel UNION SELECT o.channel dimension,'double' metric,COUNT(*) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (i.quantity=2) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel UNION SELECT o.channel dimension,'bulk' metric,COUNT(*) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (i.quantity>=3) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT LOWER(o.channel) channel,p.brand_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE LOWER(o.channel) IN ('web','app','marketplace','store') GROUP BY LOWER(o.channel),p.brand_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel dimension,'revenue' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel UNION SELECT o.channel dimension,'units' metric,SUM(i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel UNION SELECT o.channel dimension,'discount' metric,SUM(i.discount_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') day, o.channel, SUM(i.line_amount) revenue, SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{from},'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') < DATE_FORMAT(#{until},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY day,o.channel ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT DATE(i.created_at) dimension,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY DATE(i.created_at) ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT selected.id entity_id,x.* FROM sales_order selected JOIN (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) sku_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.order_id) x ON selected.id=x.order_id WHERE selected.channel='APP' ORDER BY x.revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,AVG(i.unit_price) mean_price FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.channel)='APP' ORDER BY mean_price DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m') month,p.category_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE YEAR(i.created_at)=YEAR(#{from}) GROUP BY month,p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m') dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.status)='PAID' ORDER BY revenue DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT selected.id entity_id,x.* FROM sales_order selected JOIN (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.order_id) x ON selected.id=x.order_id WHERE selected.status='PAID' ORDER BY x.revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (o.channel='MARKETPLACE' OR o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_coupon WHERE status='AVAILABLE')) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.promotion_code dimension,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.promotion_code ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.tenant_id dimension,'q1' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (QUARTER(i.created_at)=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id UNION SELECT o.tenant_id dimension,'q2' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (QUARTER(i.created_at)=2) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id UNION SELECT o.tenant_id dimension,'q3' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (QUARTER(i.created_at)=3) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id UNION SELECT o.tenant_id dimension,'q4' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (QUARTER(i.created_at)=4) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.channel)='WEB' ORDER BY units DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.customer_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER(c.email),'@',-1) domain,p.category_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE LOWER(c.email) LIKE '%@example.com' GROUP BY domain,p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT c.id entity_id,x.* FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.customer_id) x ON c.id=x.customer_id WHERE c.tier='GOLD' ORDER BY x.revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(c.tier)='GOLD' ORDER BY revenue DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(c.province)='广东' ORDER BY units DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT c.tier dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (c.tier='GOLD' OR o.customer_id IN (SELECT x.customer_id FROM sales_order x JOIN sales_order_item xi ON xi.order_id=x.id GROUP BY x.customer_id HAVING SUM(xi.line_amount)>50000)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY c.tier ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT TRIM(a.province) province,p.category_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer_address a ON a.id=o.address_id WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(a.province))>0 GROUP BY TRIM(a.province),p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT c.id entity_id,x.* FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) orders FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.customer_id) x ON c.id=x.customer_id WHERE c.province='广东' ORDER BY x.revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT c.id entity_id,x.* FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) sku_count,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.customer_id) x ON c.id=x.customer_id WHERE c.registered_at>'2024-07-01' ORDER BY x.sku_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT c.tier dimension,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_coupon x WHERE x.customer_id=o.customer_id AND x.status='AVAILABLE')) coupon_touches,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY c.tier ORDER BY coupon_touches DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.brand_id dimension,'web' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (o.channel='WEB') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id UNION SELECT p.brand_id dimension,'app' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (o.channel='APP') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id UNION SELECT p.brand_id dimension,'store' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (o.channel='STORE') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.category_id dimension,'discounted' metric,SUM(i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (i.discount_amount>0) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id UNION SELECT p.category_id dimension,'regular' metric,SUM(i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (i.discount_amount=0) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id UNION SELECT p.category_id dimension,'total' metric,COUNT(*) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.id entity_id,x.* FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON s.id=x.sku_id WHERE p.category_id=5 ORDER BY x.revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.category_id dimension,'paid' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (o.status='PAID') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id UNION SELECT p.category_id dimension,'shipped' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (o.status='SHIPPED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id UNION SELECT p.category_id dimension,'completed' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (o.status='COMPLETED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel dimension,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review x WHERE x.order_item_id=i.id)) review_count,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.id entity_id,x.* FROM sku s JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) buyers,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON s.id=x.sku_id WHERE s.price>800 ORDER BY x.buyers DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.id entity_id,x.* FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON s.id=x.sku_id WHERE p.status='OFFLINE' ORDER BY x.revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT ROUND(i.unit_price,-2) price_band,p.category_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE ROUND(i.unit_price,0)>=10 GROUP BY price_band,p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.category_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (i.fulfillment_status='RETURNED' OR i.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM product_review GROUP BY sku_id HAVING AVG(rating)<3)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.sku_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.code,p.name,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE TRIM(s.code) LIKE 'SKU-%' GROUP BY s.id,p.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.category_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (o.status='REFUNDING' OR o.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM return_order WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED','APPROVED'))) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.category_id dimension,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory x WHERE x.sku_id=i.sku_id AND x.available_qty>x.reorder_point)) available_locations,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY available_locations DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(s.weight_grams*i.quantity) weight_grams FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.status)='COMPLETED' ORDER BY weight_grams DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.shipping_fee)=0 ORDER BY revenue DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (o.status='PAID' OR o.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM shipment WHERE status='IN_TRANSIT')) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.fulfillment_status dimension,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.fulfillment_status ORDER BY line_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (o.total_amount>3500 OR o.id IN (SELECT sh.order_id FROM shipment sh JOIN shipment_event e ON e.shipment_id=sh.id GROUP BY sh.order_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.brand_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (i.quantity>=3 OR i.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM inventory WHERE available_qty<80)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.tenant_id dimension,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM return_item x WHERE x.order_item_id=i.id)) returned_lines,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY returned_lines DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,'allocated' metric,SUM(i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (i.fulfillment_status='ALLOCATED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id UNION SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,'packed' metric,SUM(i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (i.fulfillment_status='PACKED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id UNION SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,'shipped' metric,SUM(i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (i.fulfillment_status='SHIPPED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,'pending' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (o.status='PENDING') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id UNION SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,'cancelled' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (o.status='CANCELLED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id UNION SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,'refunding' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE (o.status='REFUNDING') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.warehouse_id)=1 ORDER BY revenue DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.warehouse_id dimension,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(i.created_at) weekday,o.warehouse_id,i.fulfillment_status,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE DAYOFWEEK(i.created_at) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY weekday,o.warehouse_id,i.fulfillment_status ORDER BY line_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.brand_id dimension,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order_item x WHERE x.sku_id=i.sku_id)) purchase_touches,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id ORDER BY purchase_touches DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.supplier_id dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (i.quantity=4 OR i.sku_id IN (SELECT x.sku_id FROM purchase_order_item x JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id=x.purchase_order_id WHERE po.status='ORDERED')) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.supplier_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.supplier_id dimension,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review x WHERE x.sku_id=i.sku_id AND x.rating=5)) positive_review_touches,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.supplier_id ORDER BY positive_review_touches DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.supplier_id dimension,'low' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (i.unit_price<300) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.supplier_id UNION SELECT p.supplier_id dimension,'middle' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (i.unit_price>=300 AND i.unit_price<700) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.supplier_id UNION SELECT p.supplier_id dimension,'high' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (i.unit_price>=700) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.supplier_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.id entity_id,x.* FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) buyers FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON s.id=x.sku_id WHERE p.supplier_id=11 ORDER BY x.units DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.discount_amount) discount_total FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MIN(o.ordered_at)>=#{from} AND MAX(o.ordered_at)<#{until} ORDER BY discount_total DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT p.brand_id dimension,'revenue' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id UNION SELECT p.brand_id dimension,'cost' metric,SUM(s.cost*i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id UNION SELECT p.brand_id dimension,'margin' metric,SUM(i.line_amount-s.cost*i.quantity) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE (1=1) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.id entity_id,x.* FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.discount_amount) discounts,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku ss ON ss.id=i.sku_id JOIN product pp ON pp.id=ss.product_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON s.id=x.sku_id WHERE p.brand_id=7 ORDER BY x.discounts DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,i.created_at,#{until})/30) age_months,o.status,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,i.created_at,#{until})>0 GROUP BY age_months,o.status ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.status dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel dimension,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity) units,COUNT(*) line_count FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (o.status='PENDING' OR o.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM payment WHERE status='REFUNDED')) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.tenant_id dimension,SUM(i.discount_amount) discount_total FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY discount_total DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,SUM(i.line_amount-s.cost*i.quantity) margin FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.tenant_id)=1 ORDER BY margin DESC,o.id LIMIT 50
